| This workbook provides you with an overview and detailed content of the SAP Reference Architecture Technology Capability Model (SAP RA TCM). |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| The SAP RA TCM complements  the SAP RA Business Capability Model and is structured similarly. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| The TCM Hierarchy comprises: |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Technology Domain: Level 1 of Technology Capability Hierarchy |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Technology Area: Level 2 of Technology Capability Hierarchy |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Technology Capability: Level 3 of Technology Capability Hierarchy |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Technology Soluition Capability: SAP specific implementations of Technology Capabilities |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Technology Solution Component: SAP software/service enabling a Technology Solution Capability |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| This workbook includes the following tabs: |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Read Me: The tab you are currently looking at |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - TCM 2510 Source: Full data set of the TCM 2510 release, including UIDs and descriptions where available. Please use at your own discretion for specific views. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - TCM Browsing View: A simplified view for easy browing and navigation through the TCM. Plesae expand/collapse as required to zero in on areas of interest. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - EA Tool Input Format: A specific view for easy upload to customers' own Enterprise Architecture tools. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - AI Features 2510 Source: SAP AI Agents, Solution Features and others types mapped to Reference Architecture items (Beta Release / SAP Labs Preview!) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Various views for browsing SAP AI Features from different angles. Covers all released SAP AI Features that are already mapped to SAP Reference Architecture (Beta Release / SAP Labs Preview!) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Copyright and Disclaimer: Please adhere to accordingly and do not remove from this workbook. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Please note: |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - The TCM 2510 Release includes TCM content as of End of October 2025. It is subject to potential changes with future releases. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Specifically, Technology Solution Caoabilities in the Tech Domain "Artificial Intelligence" are still preliminary and will be further consolidated and completed in TCM release 2510. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

## EA Tool Input Format

| Name | Parent | Description | Tech Capability Type | SAP Reference ID | IT Components |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Data and Analytics |  | Ability to manage, process, and analyze data to derive insights, make data-driven decisions, and drive business value. This capability encompasses a range of activities including data collection, storage, data quality management, analytics techniques, and the delivery of actionable insights to stakeholders. | Technology Domain | FD25 |  |
| Technology Area | Data and Analytics | Ability to collect, analyse, and interpret data to uncover meaningful insights and trends. This capability is crucial for driving informed decision-making, forecasting future scenarios, and optimizing business performance through effective planning and strategy development. | Technology Area | AR122 |  |
| Business Planning and Forecasting | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability of an organization to design, manage, and adjust its strategic, tactical and operational business plans. It involves analyzing historical data, market trends, and other relevant factors to develop a realistic plan for the future and allows the business to plan and align on different planning versions in a collaborative way. It also covers the use of forecasting algorithms that help to reduce uncertainty. | Technology Capability | BC1064 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP HANA Cloud |
| Data Marketplace Management | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability of organizations to curate, manage, and provide access to well-defined data products from various sources, both internal and external. This includes structured and unstructured data, which can be bought, sold, or exchanged. It involves the ability to ensure the data's quality, security, privacy, and compliance with any relevant regulations. This also includes the ability to catalogue, classify, and make the data discoverable in a manner that is user-friendly to potential buyers or data users. Furthermore, the Data Marketplace capability may also include the ability to facilitate the transaction process, such as pricing, licensing, and distribution of data. | Technology Capability | BC1065 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| Insight Sharing and Collaboration | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability for data & analytics teams to work together and share information and insights to reaching collective decisions, reporting on metrics, creating team-wide strategies, and providing cross-organizational transparency. This capability typically involves the use of collaboration tools such as shared folders, chat services, or project management applications, allowing stakeholders to securely access and edit data, reports, dashboards, and other assets. It also covers bursting, i.e. distribution of reports based on its data. | Technology Capability | BC1068 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Template Management | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to organize and manage templates used for analytics and planning purposes. These templates are typically used to standardize, accelerate and streamline the creation of reports, dashboards, planning layouts and other analytical and planning outputs. | Technology Capability | BC1069 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud |
| Knowledge Management | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to provide business knowledge through interconnected and context-aware company data by creating an ontology representing the relationships in the data, including business context. This enables organizations to deeply understand the relationships between data, metadata and business processes, as well as boost the effectiveness of machine learning and large language models. | Technology Capability | BC1201 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| Exploratory Data Analysis | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to examine and understand source data to gain insights, identify patterns, and detect anomalies, and identify relationships between variables. EDA helps in formulating hypotheses, selecting appropriate statistical techniques, and preparing the data for further analysis. | Technology Capability | BC1210 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Office Suite Integration | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to allow users to get the insights they need through slicing, dicing, and exploring data in office suite applications for intelligent decision-making. | Technology Capability | BC1257 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Analytics on Mobile | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to access and analyze data through mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets enabling organizations to leverage data insights and make timely decisions regardless of location or device. | Technology Capability | BC1287 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| AI for Planning and Analytics | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to leverage artificial intelligence technologies to enhance and optimize planning processes and analytical insight. This capability enables organizations to make faster, more data-driven decisions, improve forecast accuracy, uncover hidden insights, and optimize planning and analytics workflows through the power of AI and machine learning. | Technology Capability | BC1288 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud |
| Centralized Analytics Access | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to provide a unified, organization-wide approach to accessing and utilizing analytics resources. This capability allows organizations to gain a holistic view of their data and analytics landscape, improve governance, and drive more consistent and efficient use of analytics across business units. | Technology Capability | BC1290 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Dashboard Design | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to create visually impactful and informative dashboards that present key business information in a concise, easy-to-understand form. | Technology Capability | BC1299 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Dashboard Extensibility | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to customize and enhance existing dashboards to meet specific business needs. | Technology Capability | BC1300 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Enterprise Reporting | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to generate, distribute, and analyze standardized reports across an organization. | Technology Capability | BC1303 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Intelligent Application Management | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to uncover hidden insights and fast-track decision-making with prebuilt analytical applications. These are fully managed, built on curated data products, and incorporate pre-defined metrics, AI models, and planning capabilities, simplifying how to connect and integrate every part of a business. | Technology Capability | BC1423 | SAP Business Data Cloud |
| Embedded Analytics | Data and Analytics / Analytics and Planning | Ability to analyze and visualize data directly in the source system. This eliminates the need for complicated and time-consuming data preparation steps because data processing happens directly at the source. | Technology Capability | BC1487 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition |
| Analytics and Planning | Data and Analytics | Ability to effectively collect, store, organize, and govern data throughout its lifecycle, ensuring its accuracy, security, and availability. This capability is essential for enabling access to high-quality, reliable data that supports analytics, operational processes, and strategic decision-making. | Technology Area | AR123 |  |
| Business Content Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to deliver and reuse prebuild industry-specific, LOB-specific or solution specific data models and analytics content like reports and dashboards. This content reflects business context, use cases or business scenarios based on technical best practices. | Technology Capability | BC1070 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA |
| Business Semantics Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to manage a semantic layer that systematically defines, links, and manages business terms and semantics across data sources and data models within an organization. It involves creating a unified, consistent and business-oriented view of data. By establishing common definitions and relationships among data elements business stakeholders will be empowered to understand and use data more efficiently. | Technology Capability | BC1071 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Data Intelligence Cloud |
| Data Connectivity Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to enable controlled external outbound and inbound access to data via standard connectivity techniques. | Technology Capability | BC1072 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Data Design and Modelling | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to design, construct and implement data models from an abstract level (conceptual and logical data models) to a detailed data schema at the physical level of a data storage management system (physical data models). The former involves structuring, organizing data elements, defining entities and their relationships that are often visualized through diagrams such as entity-relationship diagrams (ERDs). The latter is used for optimizing performance and ensuring data integrity and security, while taking  into account factors like hardware constraints, storage capacity, memory, and processing power. The goal of data modelling is to facilitate communication between stakeholders (like developers, designers, and business users) and provide a high-level understanding of the data landscape. | Technology Capability | BC1074 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Data Processing | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to handle and manage data that comes from multiple sources and in different formats (structured, semi- and unstructured data) to prepare it for further use. This capability involves techniques for extracting, manipulating, and integrating information from these diverse data types. The main goal of data processing is to optimize the data for usability, consistency, and to facilitate streamlined and effective data analysis. | Technology Capability | BC1078 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA Cloud |
| Data Product Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to oversee the development, launch, and continuous improvement of data-driven products. These products leverage data and analytics to deliver value and solve problems for business stakeholders or external parties. | Technology Capability | BC1079 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| Data Storage Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to manage data storage technologies / systems to efficiently store, back up, archive, and manage diverse data types (structured, semi- and unstructured data) for an organization. This discipline encompasses a range of tasks such as data tiering, data protection, disaster recovery, scaling of storage resources or storage monitoring. It involves the use of various storage technologies and tools, ensuring data accessibility, integrity, security, and privacy. | Technology Capability | BC1080 | SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise, SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise, cloud edition by IBM Cloud, SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry runtime and environment |
| Data Lifecycle Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to manage the entire life cycle of data, from creation or collection to disposal or archival. The stages of the data lifecycle might include creation, processing, storage, usage, archiving, and deletion. It involves determining the economic and business value of data at each stage of the life cycle, and using this information to make decisions about how the data should be handled. This might include policies on data retention, data protection, data privacy, and data archiving. | Technology Capability | BC1150 | SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA, platform edition |
| Data Workspace Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to manage, govern, and operate data within specific business domains as decentralized, autonomous units. Each domain team is responsible for the full lifecycle of the data they produce, from its creation, quality assurance, security, privacy, discoverability to its operational use. You need to be able to manage data models and connections in one secured and governed place, and collaborate between peers through clearly defined access authorizations. This also includes resource allocation like disc space and memory or workload configuration.. | Technology Capability | BC1203 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| DataOps Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to combine principles, practices, and tools to streamline and automate the processes involved in managing and delivering data within an organization. It aims to improve the efficiency, quality, and reliability of data operations by applying agile and DevOps methodologies to data management. DataOps focuses on integrating data engineering, data integration, data governance, and data quality processes into a cohesive and collaborative framework. It emphasizes close collaboration between data engineers, data scientists, data analysts, and other stakeholders involved in the data lifecycle. | Technology Capability | BC1205 | SAP Business Data Cloud |
| Self-Service Data Preparation | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability for business users to independently access, manipulate, and transform raw data into a format suitable for analysis or reporting purposes. It empowers users to perform data cleansing, integration, and enrichment tasks without relying on IT or data specialists. | Technology Capability | BC1206 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Document Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to receive, track, manage, and store documents. It enables you to keep record of the various versions created and modified by different users. This lets you build document management capabilities for your business applications and to securely store and manage your business documents and attachments using various components. Document management can be a component of enterprise content management (ECM) systems.?? | Technology Capability | BC1259 | SAP Archiving and Document Access by OpenText, SAP Build, SAP Build Code |
| Data and Analytics Administration | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to manage a solution which includes configuration and housekeeping tasks such as performance monitoring and archiving. | Technology Capability | BC1289 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Geodata Management | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to integrate, analyze, and visualize geographical information with business data, enabling organizations to unlock valuable insights and make informed decisions. | Technology Capability | BC1383 | SAP HANA spatial services |
| Business Warehouse Modernization | Data and Analytics / Data Management | Ability to preserve their business warehouse investments in the transition from an on premise to a cloud software world. | Technology Capability | BC1444 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP BW/4HANA Cloud |
| Data Management | Data and Analytics | Ability to continuously assess, improve, and maintain the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and uniqueness of data. This capability ensures that data is fit for its intended use, supports reliable analytics and decision-making, and maximizes the value of data as a strategic asset. | Technology Area | AR124 |  |
| Data Preparation | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to execute the conversion of processed data into a clean, organized, and usable format for defined analytical use cases. It involves orchestration of various data quality services such as data cleansing (removing errors, inconsistencies, and duplicates from the dataset), validating, enrichment and profiling. The primary objective of data preparation is to ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of the data, which is crucial for laying the foundation for effective data analysis and decision-making. | Technology Capability | BC1082 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence platform |
| Data Quality Monitoring and Analysis | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to measure, assess and validate the quality dimensions of data (uniqueness, accuracy, completeness, consistency, reliability, validity and timeliness) used in business operations and decision-making processes. If data does not meet defined or expected quality dimensions and KPIs follow-up activities need to be initiated to resolve issues. | Technology Capability | BC1083 | SAP Information Steward |
| Data Quality Rules Management | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to define, create, implement, and maintain data quality rules for an organization. These rules combine data quality services to create data that is fit for use by data consumers, i.e. accurate, complete, consistent, and of an acceptable standard. | Technology Capability | BC1084 | SAP Data Services, SAP HANA smart data integration |
| Data Quality Services Management | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to identify and eliminate erroneous data and maximize the value of data. This involves services that support the execution of data quality processes, such as data cleansing and data enrichment. It also includes execution of layered processes to ensure data integrity, such as data collection, data reformatting, data matching, and data transformation techniques. | Technology Capability | BC1085 | SAP Data Quality Management, microservices for location data, SAP Data Services, SAP HANA smart data integration |
| Data Observability | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to holistically understand the state and health of an organization’s data, data pipelines, data landscapes, data infrastructures, and financial governance of the data. This is accomplished by continuously monitoring, tracking, alerting, analyzing and troubleshooting problems to reduce and prevent data errors or downtime. | Technology Capability | BC1207 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| Data Profiling | Data and Analytics / Data Quality Management | Ability to analyze and examine source data to gain insights into its structure, quality, and content. It helps in understanding the characteristics of data, such as its range, distribution, completeness, and uniqueness. By performing data profiling, organizations can identify data issues, anomalies, and patterns, enabling them to define data quality improvement opportunities. | Technology Capability | BC1208 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere |
| Data Quality Management | Data and Analytics | Ability to create, maintain, and utilize descriptive data about other data, providing context, definitions, and lineage. This capability enables effective data discovery, understanding, and governance, which enhances data usability, interoperability, and management across the organization. | Technology Area | AR138 |  |
| Data Discovery | Data and Analytics / Metadata Management | Ability to find, understand and locate data entities in the data landscape required to fulfil the needs from data consumers. This covers searching for data entities, understanding their business context (business glossary and taxonomies), structure and content, and identifying ownership. It also involves the identification of potential data sources like business applications, databases or files. | Technology Capability | BC1075 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Data Intelligence Cloud |
| Data Lineage and Impact Analysis | Data and Analytics / Metadata Management | Ability to track and understand the flow of data within their systems. It provides a clear and comprehensive view of how data is transformed and used throughout its lifecycle. Additionally, it enables organizations to assess the potential impact of changes or issues on their data, helping them make informed decisions and ensure data quality and integrity. | Technology Capability | BC1087 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Data Intelligence Cloud |
| Metadata Interoperability | Data and Analytics / Metadata Management | Ability of different systems or platforms to exchange and understand metadata in a consistent and meaningful way. This covers the connection and extraction (automated ingestion of metadata objects from various sources using prebuilt metadata API) and export (for reporting or sharing with other third party tools) of metadata from remote systems like technical data sources or other data catalog instances in distributed data catalog environments. | Technology Capability | BC1088 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Data Intelligence Cloud |
| Metadata Process Management | Data and Analytics / Metadata Management | Ability to define and apply systematic procedures and workflows to collecting, storing, organizing and maintaining metadata. It contains features like auditing (Who did what?), collaboration, rating and tagging. | Technology Capability | BC1089 | SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence, SAP Data Intelligence Cloud |
| Data and Analytics Cataloging | Data and Analytics / Metadata Management | Ability to systematically organize and manage business and technical information about core data entities and data products to make such data more accessible and understandable. The catalogue is the central place to discover, enrich, classify, and publish high-quality, trusted analytic assets and data entities from across your enterprise. Metadata information covers business information like business glossary, business rules, ownership, data classification or access controls. Technical information can include data source, data type definition and logical and physical data models | Technology Capability | BC1209 | SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Data Intelligence |
| Metadata Management | Data and Analytics | Ability to ensure the quality of an organization's core data assets across systems and processes. This involves creating and maintaining a single, authoritative source of master data, enabling efficient data governance, and supporting data-driven decision-making throughout the enterprise. | Technology Area | AR161 |  |
| Master Data Quality Management | Data and Analytics / Master Data Management | Ability to monitor the master data quality for analysis and correction. Master data quality management involves defining quality standards by maintaining data quality rules for an organization, entering accurate master data, and continuously monitoring, analyzing and improving master data quality. | Technology Capability | BC1224 | SAP Master Data Governance, cloud edition, SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition |
| Master Data Consolidation | Data and Analytics / Master Data Management | Ability to consolidate master data from various sources to identify and merge duplicates into a best record and provide key-mapping information. | Technology Capability | BC1225 | SAP Master Data Governance, cloud edition, SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition |
| Master Data Central Governance | Data and Analytics / Master Data Management | Ability to centrally govern the creation and change of master data in-line with business processes to ensure high data quality at the point of data entry, and distribute the data across the complete enterprise system landscape. | Technology Capability | BC1227 | SAP Master Data Governance, cloud edition, SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition |
| Master Data Mass Maintenance | Data and Analytics / Master Data Management | Ability to perform mass maintenance on master data in one system. | Technology Capability | BC1237 | SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition |
| IT Security |  | Ability to ensure compliant access to and management of protected resources with the help of technologies and processes | Technology Domain | FD27 |  |
| Master Data Management | IT Security | Ability to manage personal data adhering to legal regulations concerning users' private information | Technology Area | AR148 |  |
| Data Privacy Management | IT Security / Data Privacy and Compliance | Ability to protect personal and sensitive data to ensure compliance with relevant privacy laws, regulations, and industry standards. The Data Privacy capability encompasses various practices and measures aimed at safeguarding the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal information. It involves implementing controls and procedures to prevent unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, or destruction of data. | Technology Capability | BC1093 | Data Retention Manager, SAP Data Privacy Integration |
| Personal Data Information Handling | IT Security / Data Privacy and Compliance | Ability to handle personal data information. | Technology Capability | BC1171 | SAP Personal Data Manager |
| Compliance Data Management | IT Security / Data Privacy and Compliance | Ability to systematically collect, store, and maintain information that is necessary to demonstrate adherence to policies. This includes tracking changes to data, ensuring its integrity and security, and making it readily available for audits and reporting. | Technology Capability | BC1341 | SAP Audit Log Management service |
| Information Lifecycle Management | IT Security / Data Privacy and Compliance | Ability to manage the information lifecycle in order to make sure that data within an organization is retained, archived, and disposed of in a manner that complies with legal requirements, business needs, and best practices. | Technology Capability | BC1545 |  |
| Data Privacy and Compliance | IT Security | Ability to manage the identity lifecycle, authentication and single sign-on and govern access to applications and platforms | Technology Area | AR149 |  |
| Authentication and Single Sign-On | IT Security / Identity Governance and Administration | ability to support authentication - incl multifactor authentication - and single sign-on capabilities | Technology Capability | BC1172 | SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Secure Login Client |
| Identity Lifecycle Management | IT Security / Identity Governance and Administration | Ability to manage identities, including user-group and user-role assignments. | Technology Capability | BC1173 | Identity Provisioning, SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Identity Management |
